text:
maya (product): Quick GA checklist convo: we need concise, publishable acceptance criteria for the adaptive-routing launch (SLA text, docs blurb, pricing mode, runbook + oncall, monitoring tiles). Who owns which line items?

liam (eng): I can own SLA wording and metric names. Propose: public availability = 99.9% for initial GA; internal perf SLO p99 < 400ms. Will post the metric queries.

zoe (sre): I'll own runbook and alerts. Pager if p99 > 600ms for 5m or error-rate > 3% for 5m. Runbook steps: detect -> throttle -> fallback -> notify -> escalate. I'll add synthetic checks and a "fallback rate" panel.

tony (pricing): Pricing prefers opt-in surcharge for early GA customers. Recommend multiplier 1.5x for on-demand burst. Need a short UI copy and sample invoice line. Default OFF.

elaine (docs): I'll draft the customer expectations doc + FAQ. Need exact SLA sentence and billing example. Also add a short sentence about fallback: "May route to reduced-capacity variant; output quality may differ."

carlos (support): Support playbook: immediate workaround = disable opt-in for affected account; escalate to eng after 10min if >5 customers affected. I'll draft canned messages and a troubleshooting checklist (Console steps).

ops-bot: Created ticket: AR-2026-ga-ready-checklist (assignee: zoe).

liam (eng): Small config snippet for ops repo: ```yaml
adaptive_routing:
  opt_in_default: false
  surge_multiplier: 1.5
```

zoe (sre): I'll link dashboards: availability-by-region, p99-by-route, fallback-engagement-rate, estimated-billing-impact. Will open runbook PR today.

tony (pricing): UI copy suggestion: "Adaptive routing surge (opt-in) — 1.5x token surcharge during surge windows (pilot/GA rate subject to change)." Also: show "Estimated monthly delta" before enabling.

elaine (docs): Draft will include: SLA line, fallback caveat, sample invoice row, "how to opt-out" steps, and support contact steps. Will tag legal + finance for wording review.

maya (product): Owners recap: SLA & metrics -> liam; runbook & alerts -> zoe; pricing text & billing preview -> tony; docs + FAQ -> elaine; support templates -> carlos. Decision: default OFF for GA. Finalize public wording tomorrow 10:00 PT. Anything blocking?

liam (eng): Blocker: need legal confirmation on SLA carve-out language for fallbacks.

maya (product): Noted — I'll ping legal now. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

(ended thread)
